China Times and other local newspapers:-
NEW COMMISSIONER OF FINANCE BUREAU AND LAND BUREAU.
Zee Fu (徐桴 ), member of the Fokien
Provincial Government and concurrently Chief of the
Finance Department of the Provincial Government, who is
also General Manager of the Shing Nyih Trust Company (兴业信托社),
has been recommended by Mayor Wu Te Chen as Commissioner of
the Finance Bureau and the Land Bureau of the Shanghai
City Government, which post was recently vacated by Tsai
Tseng Chi (蔡增基), the new General Manager of the
China Merchants Steam Navigation Company. The Executive
Yuan at Nanking has approved the recommendation.
Zee Fu has been in Shanghai for two weeks to
attend to his duties with the Shing Nyih Trust Company.
He will leave for Fokien in a few days to make preparations
to hand over his posts to his successor.

China Times and other local newspapers: 17-3-36
LOCAL JOINT COMMISSIONER OF LAND AND FINACE ASSUMES
POSTS
Zee Fu (徐桴 ), the newly appointed Commissioner

City Government, took over his offices at 9.30 a.m.
yesterday.

财政局与土地局新任局长。
福建省政府委员兼省政府财政厅厅长，同时担任兴业信托社总经理的徐桴（Zee Fu），经市长吴铁城推荐，出任上海市政府财政局与土地局局长，该职位近日因招商局新任总经理蔡增基（Tsai Tseng Chi）离职而空缺。南京行政院已批准此项推荐。
徐桴已在上海两周，处理其在兴业信托社的职务。他将于数日后前往福建，准备将其职务移交给继任者。

New Presiding Judge of the Soon; Wu Military Court (工入 -2、i()
assumes office

Mr. Loh Ching-dz (陸京士 ), the newly appointed
Presiding Judge of the Military Court attached to the
Shanghai Woosung Defence Commissioner's Headquarters,
assumed office on February 1. This post became vacant
owing to the resignation of Mr. Tao Fah-chuen (陶百川 ),
who has left for Europe to further his knowledge of law
and western politics.

淞沪军事法庭新任审判长就职

淞沪防卫司令总部附属军事法庭新任审判长陆京士（Loh Ching-dz）先生于二月一日就职。此职位因陶百川（Tao Fah-chuen）先生辞职而出缺，陶氏已前往欧洲深造法律及西方政治学。

Subject (in full) Principal officers of the various chinese official
organizations in Shanghai.

Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao-liang.

A Principal officers of the Public Safety Bureau

1. Gen. Wen Chao Chi, the new Commissioner, who will probably
take over the post on January 1, 1935. He was formerly
Commander of the 78th Division at Wuhu.

2. Col. Tan Pao Zeu, the Chief Superintendent. His duties
include supervision of various Police Stations in the
different districts in Chinese territory. A returned student
from America, he speaks English fluently and acts sometimes
as a liaison officer between the foreign authorities and
the Chinese Police.

3. Dr. Hung Chi, Chief of the 2nd Department, Public Safety
Bureau, deals with amongst other things, affairs relating
to passports, registration of Russians, diplomatic matters,
etc.

4. Dr. Hwang Hwa, in charge 3rd Department, Public Safety
Bureau, also a returned student and speaks English.
Deals with preliminary trials of prisoners arrested in
Chinese territory and the handing over of men to the
Settlement Authorities.

5. Col. Paul Lee, Secretary to the Commissioner, Public Safety
Bureau. Deals with correspondence, invitations, social
affairs of the Commissioner. Speaks good English and
Japanese.

6. Col. Lu Ying, Chief Detective Officer. His duties are
indicated by his rank.

7. Col. Waung Ta Jui, Officer i/c of the 6th Division at Zau
Ka Too (Jessfield). He is a returned student from
America and speaks good English. He controls the Western
Districts adjoining the Settlement.
